issue: उत्पत्ति बाला बिनाशन तू सब की माता — the book, Drik Panchang and instaastro.com print बाला ('girl, young one'), which fits poorly in what looks like a list (creation … destruction); Bhakti Bharat (bhaktibharat.com) prints उत्पत्ति व्याधि बिनाशन तू सब की घाता, 'you destroy disease as it arises' (fitting Śītalā, who wards off disease). The witnesses disagree, so the text and the reading stay as printed.
our reading: उत्पत्ति बाला बिनाशन (as printed): (you are) creation, the young one (Bālā), destruction, the mother of all.
alternatives: उत्पत्ति व्याधि बिनाशन (Bhakti Bharat): you destroy disease at its outbreak; उत्पत्ति पाला बिनाशन (creation, sustenance, destruction), not attested; बाला as वाला: 'the one of creation and destruction'
